cases.name: ordinary atomic append
checks: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM heimdall_retention.event_identities WHERE product_id='ledger' AND environment='staging' AND event_id='retained-ordinary')

cases.name: late identity failure rolls back entire request
cases.before: CREATE FUNCTION heimdall_retention.fail_retained_test() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN IF NEW.decision_id='retained-decision' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'injected' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $$; CREATE TRIGGER fail_retained_test BEFORE INSERT ON heimdall_retention.decision_identities FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION heimdall_retention.fail_retained_test()

cases.name: insufficient metadata rolls back entire request
cases.before: DROP TRIGGER fail_retained_test ON heimdall_retention.decision_identities; DROP FUNCTION heimdall_retention.fail_retained_test(); UPDATE heimdall_retention.capacity SET row_limit=used_rows+reserved_rows+3,byte_limit=(used_rows+reserved_rows+3)*8192

cases.name: pending reserves terminal metadata
checks: SELECT resolution='pending' FROM heimdall_retention.decision_identities WHERE product_id='ledger' AND environment='staging' AND decision_id='retained-decision'
